data.title: Commercial Planning Senior Associate
data.description:
Commercial Planning Senior Associate

About the team

The Commercial Planning team sits at the heart of SumUp's commercial engine, turning complex data into the financial insight that shapes how we grow. We partner closely with channel leads, marketing, and product teams to make sure our planning is accurate, proactive, and genuinely useful to the people making decisions. We need someone who can own the analytical workstreams for our Acquisitions channels while building the kind of trusted relationships that make finance business partnering actually work. If you're energised by owning complex models, influencing commercial decisions, and being the person stakeholders turn to when they need clarity, this is the role for you.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end revenue and customer acquisition budget (CAB) planning for acquisition channels, building scalable financial models, running scenario analyses, and delivering proactive performance insights to senior stakeholders
  • Act as the primary finance business partner for channel leads, building trusted relationships, embedding financial models into commercial decision-making, and influencing assumptions through rigorous analysis
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses at country, merchant category, and channel level to surface revenue risks and opportunities, and present findings clearly to senior, non-technical audiences
  • Build business cases and product-level revenue forecasts to support existing and new product growth initiatives
  • Contribute to the migration of commercial planning from spreadsheets to scalable forecasting tools, and help reduce manual effort in month-end reporting workflows
  • Provide day-to-day guidance to an intern and/or analyst, helping them develop their skills and navigate complex analytical tasks

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Strong experience in FP&A, revenue planning, business analytics, or management consulting, with a track record of owning complex analytical workstreams independently
  • Expert-level financial modelling skills, including multi-driver models and scenario analysis, with advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Proven ability to act as a trusted finance business partner to commercial or marketing stakeholders, comfortable influencing decisions and building relationships across functions
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction and manipulation from large datasets
  • Clear and structured communicator, able to translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable insight for senior non-technical audiences
  • Comfort working in fast-moving environments where priorities shift, and structure is still being built

Why you should join SumUp

About SumUp

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

data.title: Online-Marketing-Manager | E-Commerce, SEO & GEO (m/w/d)
data.description:
Du begeisterst dich für SEO, GEO, KI und E-Commerce und möchtest digitale Sichtbarkeit nicht nur analysieren, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln? Dann werde Teil von D-I-S commerce engineering und arbeite mit uns an spannenden Online-Marketing-Projekten für B2B- und B2C-Kund:innen.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust eigene Kund:innen aus dem B2B- und B2C-E-Commerce und bist für SEO- und GEO-Themen eine zentrale Ansprechperson.
  • Du analysierst Onlineshops – insbesondere auf Basis von Shopware 6 – und identifizierst Potenziale in den Bereichen technisches SEO, Content, Informationsarchitektur, interne Verlinkung und Sichtbarkeit.
  • Du denkst SEO und GEO gemeinsam: klassische Suchmaschinen, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity und weitere generative Such- und Antwortsysteme gehören für dich zu einer ganzheitlichen Search-Strategie.
  • Du entwickelst Maßnahmen, mit denen Produkte, Kategorien, Marken und Ratgeberinhalte sowohl für klassische Suchmaschinen als auch für LLMs und Answer Engines besser auffindbar und verständlich werden.
  • Du führst Keyword-, Wettbewerbs- und Potenzialanalysen durch und leitest daraus konkrete Empfehlungen für Kategorie-, Produkt- und Content-Seiten ab.
  • Du übersetzt technische SEO-Anforderungen in konkrete Aufgaben für unsere Shopware-Entwicklung und arbeitest bei der Umsetzung eng mit unseren Entwickler:innen zusammen.
  • Du analysierst Rankings und weitere relevante Daten, entwickelst Hypothesen und überprüfst anhand messbarer Ergebnisse, welche Maßnahmen Wirkung zeigen.
  • Du begleitest Shop-Relaunches, Migrationen und Produktivsetzungen aus SEO-Sicht – beispielsweise bei URL-Strukturen, Weiterleitungen, Indexierung, Crawling und der Absicherung bestehender Rankings.
  • Du beobachtest die Entwicklung von Search, generativer KI und Agentic Search und bewertest, welche neuen Technologien und Methoden für unsere E-Commerce-Kund:innen relevant sind.
  • Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unseres SEO-/GEO-Bereichs ein – zum Beispiel durch neue Methoden, Standards, Tools, Tests und internen Wissenstransfer.
  • Du arbeitest parallel an mehreren Kundenprojekten, priorisierst deine Aufgaben eigenständig und vertrittst deine fachlichen Einschätzungen gegenüber Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast erste praktische Erfahrung im SEO, beispielsweise als Werkstudent:in, durch eigene Projekte oder durch etwa 1 bis 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung.
  • Du kennst die Grundlagen von technischem und inhaltlichem SEO und möchtest dein Wissen insbesondere im E-Commerce-Umfeld weiter vertiefen.
  • Du interessierst dich dafür, wie sich Suche durch generative KI, LLMs und Answer Engines verändert, und möchtest diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Berührungspunkte mit Onlineshops, Shopware 6 oder anderen Shopsystemen – das ist jedoch kein Muss.
  • Du bringst ein grundsätzliches technisches Verständnis mit und kannst dich in Themen wie Crawling, Indexierung, strukturierte Daten, URL-Strukturen oder Weiterleitungen einarbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Daten, hinterfragst Ergebnisse und möchtest verstehen, warum eine Maßnahme funktioniert – oder warum nicht.
  • Du kannst dir neues Wissen selbstständig erarbeiten, probierst neue Ansätze aus und holst dir aktiv Feedback.
  • Der direkte Austausch mit Kund:innen liegt dir. Du kannst fachliche Empfehlungen verständlich erklären und deine Einschätzung sachlich vertreten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenprojekten den Überblick.
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

Benefits

  • Eigenverantwortliches und abwechslungsreiches Arbeiten: Du bekommst den Freiraum, eigene Themen und Kundenprojekte aktiv voranzutreiben und deine Ideen einzubringen.
  • Spannende Projekte aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen: Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche B2B- und B2C-E-Commerce-Projekte mit immer neuen fachlichen Herausforderungen.
  • Persönliche Entwicklungs- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dein Wissen rund um SEO, GEO, E-Commerce und neue Technologien kontinuierlich auszubauen.
  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung: Deine Verantwortung, Erfahrung und Entwicklung spiegeln sich auch in deiner Vergütung wider.
  • Ein starkes Team: Dich erwartet eine freundliche und kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der Zusammenarbeit und Spaß an der Arbeit zusammengehören.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office: Du kannst deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten und nach Absprache auch im Home-Office arbeiten.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Wir setzen auf eine nachhaltige Zusammenarbeit und bieten dir die Möglichkeit, dich langfristig fachlich und persönlich bei D-I-S weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents: Auch abseits des Projektalltags kommt der gemeinsame Austausch nicht zu kurz.

Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen keine Person, die bereits auf jede Frage eine Antwort hat. Wir suchen jemanden, der verstehen möchte, was funktioniert, Ergebnisse kritisch hinterfragt und gemeinsam mit uns die Sichtbarkeit und den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg der Onlineshops unserer Kund:innen weiterentwickelt.

Das klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich bei uns – wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

data.description:
Wir handeln THG-Quoten und betreiben mit Elektrovorteil eine der aktiven B2C-Marken im Markt. Hinter dem Wachstum steht ein kleines, schnelles Team, das seine Prozesse konsequent mit KI und eigenen Tools skaliert statt mit mehr Köpfen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der unser Backoffice auf dieses Niveau hebt: Abläufe, die heute noch von Hand laufen, sind bei dir nächste Woche automatisiert. Gleichzeitig bist du unser Gesicht am Standort Grünwald und sorgst dafür, dass Technik und Büro einfach funktionieren. Wenn du KI als tägliches Werkzeug nutzt und dir kein Thema zu klein ist, um es sauber zu lösen, passt die Rolle.

Deine Mission

Du machst unser Backoffice schnell und verlässlich, indem du wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisierst, unsere interne IT und Geräte am Laufen hältst und den Standort Grünwald organisierst.

Aufgaben

  • Backoffice automatisieren: Du findest wiederkehrende manuelle Abläufe (Postbearbeitung, Dokumente, Datenpflege, Reporting) und ersetzt sie durch Automatisierungen, Skripte und KI-Workflows (Claude Code und vergleichbare Tools).
  • Von der Anforderung zum laufenden Ablauf: Du nimmst Anforderungen aus dem Team auf und setzt sie schnell in funktionierende, verlässliche Lösungen um. Prototyp heute, produktiv diese Woche.
  • IT-Administration: Du verwaltest Benutzer und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365 und bist erste Anlaufstelle für IT-Alltagsfragen im Team.
  • Geräte-Management: Du richtest Laptops und Hardware ein, gibst sie beim Onboarding aus, nimmst sie beim Offboarding zurück und hältst den Bestand sauber dokumentiert.
  • Standort Grünwald: Du übernimmst Post, Empfang, Terminorganisation und allgemeine Sekretariats- und Office-Tätigkeiten und hältst damit Team und Geschäftsführung den Rücken frei.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast schon Automatisierungen gebaut, mit Tools wie Power Automate, Make, n8n oder Zapier, gern auch mit Skripten (Python oder PowerShell). Wie lange du das schon machst, ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was dabei herauskommt.
  • Du arbeitest bereits mit KI-Werkzeugen und hast Lust, damit echte Abläufe zu bauen statt nur zu experimentieren.
  • Du kennst Microsoft 365 aus Anwender- und idealerweise aus Admin-Sicht; Erfahrung mit Geräte-Einrichtung ist ein Plus.
  • Du bist hands-on: Entwickeln, Admin-Aufgaben und Büro-Organisation sind für dich kein Widerspruch, sondern eine Rolle.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und diskret und kommunizierst klar auf Deutsch.
  • Du bist vor Ort in Grünwald bei München.

Benefits

  • Echten Gestaltungsspielraum in einem profitablen, wachsenden Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen direkt zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Ein Umfeld, das KI nicht diskutiert, sondern einsetzt. Du bekommst die Werkzeuge und das Mandat, deine eigenen Routineaufgaben wegzuautomatisieren.
  • Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, geht in Tagen live und wird genutzt.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, moderne Ausstattung, ein fester Platz in einem Team, das remote arbeitet und sich in Grünwald trifft.

Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns reden.

data.title: Operational QA Manager for Application Software Development (m/w/x)
data.description:
Projektbeschreibung:

Begeistern Sie sich für Technik? Wir auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Funk- und Kommunikationsbranche suchen wir einen Operational QA Manager for Application Software Development (m/w/x) für eine Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie persönlich kennenzulernen – und gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft und Teamgeist an spannenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien zu arbeiten.

Aufgaben:

  • Planung der Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätsförderung -> operative Überwachung der Qualitätssicherung in den eingebetteten Scrum-Teams sowie Unterstützung bei der Verfeinerung des Backlogs und der Sprint-/Release-Planung
  • Testmanagement und Release-Koordination -> Überwachung aller Testphasen (von Unit- bis hin zu Abnahmetests), einschließlich der Erstellung von Testplänen, der täglichen Release-Verfolgung, der Abdeckungsanalyse und der abschließenden Berichterstellung
  • Schnittstellenfunktion und Zusammenarbeit -> fungiert als zentraler Ansprechpartner für die Koordination testbezogener Themen zwischen internen Entwicklungsteams (z. B. ELINT, COMINT), externen Partnern und externen QA-Teams in Singapur und Indien
  • Prozessüberwachung & Fehlermanagement -> Überwachung der Prozesskonformität und Qualitätsstandards, Verwaltung des Lebenszyklus der Fehlerverfolgung sowie der Fehlerprüfungsgremien, um eine effektive Priorisierung sicherzustellen
  • Review-Management & Berichterstattung -> Verwaltung technischer Reviews und Dokumentationsprüfungen unter Verwendung von Qualitätskennzahlen und Dashboards, um eine transparente Berichterstattung über den Projektstatus zu gewährleisten
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und strategische Umsetzung -> Operative Umsetzung der Qualitätssicherungsstrategie, Weiterentwicklung von Test- und Automatisierungsverfahren sowie Funktion als Feedback-Schleife für den Lead QA Manager, um die Qualität und Liefergeschwindigkeit kontinuierlich zu steigern

Qualifikationen:

  • Ausbildung: Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Kommunikationstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Schwerpunkt Softwareentwicklung.
  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement komplexer Systemsoftware und im Umgang mit einem Team von Qualitätsspezialisten. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung verteilter Echtzeitsysteme oder eingebetteter Software ist ein wesentlicher Vorteil.
  • Fachwissen: Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Signalverarbeitung, Funktechnik oder Signalaufklärung (SIGINT).
  • Methodik: Sicherer Umgang mit Testautomatisierungstools und ALM-Tools (z. B. Jira, Xray, Confluence oder Jama). Erfahrung mit agilen (Scrum, Kanban) sowie klassischen V-Modell-Prozessen.
  • Analytische und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten: Eine strukturierte, detailorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge schnell zu erfassen und unter Zeit- und Lieferdruck fundierte Empfehlungen abzugeben.
  • Persönlichkeit: Sie sind ein Teamplayer mit einer praxisorientierten Mentalität, der gerne im Hintergrund die operativen Details verwaltet, um eine reibungslose Ausführung sicherzustellen.
  • Sprachen & Kommunikation: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (aufgrund der Art des Projekts). Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Qualitätsinformationen an technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder zu vermitteln.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Nutzt gewonnene Erkenntnisse und Leistungsdaten, um die Qualität der Ergebnisse zu verbessern, und fördert Innovationen.
  • Sicherheitsüberprüfung: Bereitschaft, eine Geheimhaltungsvereinbarung zu unterzeichnen und sich gegebenenfalls einer Sicherheitsüberprüfung (Ü2/Ü3) zu unterziehen.

Bewerbungen schwerbehinderter beziehungsweise gleichgestellter Menschen im Sinne des SGB IX sind eindeutig erwünscht. Sie werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.

Wir haben Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt mit aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse) ausschließlich über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular. Die Bewerbungsfrist endet am 07.09.2026.

The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Back-End Software Engineer who wants to build ambitious AI features and own them end-to-end, from idea to production.
The team is moving quickly on LLM-powered and agentic experiences, and the technical foundation of this role is back-end engineering: designing the services, protocols, and data flows that make these features reliable, fast, and scalable. At the same time, this is not a narrowly defined back-end position. The right person is comfortable moving across the stack when the product demands it—whether that means working on a client platform, a shared protocol, or the infrastructure needed to bring a feature to life.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll take on sizeable, often ambiguous problems, shape the scope, estimate the work, and make the quality, cost, and latency trade-offs that are unique to AI products. You'll ship in tight iterations, learn from real user behavior, and keep improving the experience.
The ideal person is a back-end-strong, stack-flexible builder who enjoys turning unclear problems into shipped products and can take an AI feature from concept to users with minimal hand-holding.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. You can hear more from our team on our technical blog.

As a Back-End Engineer on this team, you will:

  • Build ambitious, LLM-powered and agentic AI features and own them end-to-end, from idea to production.

  • Design the services, protocols, and data flows that make AI features reliable, fast, and scalable.

  • Start building and pushing code in your first week and ship impactful features in your first few months.

  • Build and support production services with high call rates, targeting high availability for consumer and enterprise customers.

  • Take on sizeable, ambiguous problems—shaping scope, estimating work, and making the quality, cost, and latency trade-offs that are unique to AI products.

  • Move across the stack when the product demands it, from a client platform to a shared protocol to the infrastructure that brings a feature to life.

  • Learn how to build infrastructure as code (IaC).

  • Ship in tight iterations and learn from real user behavior to keep improving the experience.

  • Have the opportunity to mentor new hires and help raise the engineering bar across the team.

Qualifications

  • Has 5+ years of relevant experience in back-end development.

  • Describes themselves as back-end-strong but stack-agnostic, and is comfortable working across the stack—including on client platforms or shared protocols—when the product needs it.

  • Has hands-on experience building or integrating LLM-powered or agentic features (well beyond a one-off API call), with a real feel for the cost, latency, streaming, and quality/false-positive trade-offs that come with AI products.

  • Is proficient in one or more of Java, Go, or Python.

  • Has experience with AWS or GCP (other cloud offerings such as Azure are a plus).

  • Displays excellent software engineering fundamentals, including knowledge of algorithms and data structures.

  • Has experience building, deploying, and debugging production systems at scale.

  • Demonstrates perseverance when faced with tough technical issues.

  • Cares about the end-user experience and strives to ensure high quality.

  • Collaborates effectively with cross-functional partners—product managers, designers, linguists, and engineers on other platforms—rather than shipping in isolation.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

We encourage you to apply

You will focus on coordinating our Integrations Team, managing our partner network, drafting requirements for their software and hardware solutions, and engaging in root cause analyses to provide a high platform stability. You will ensure the best is yet to come when it comes to heat pumps

Drive these initiatives together with internal and external stakeholders towards rapid execution to manifest 1KOMMA5°'s leading role in the market.
  • Act as a point of contact for our heat pump OEM partners, supporting efforts to adapt and integrate their solutions with our systems and ensure that things are always running smoothly for our customers.

Dein Profil

data.title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
data.description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

Your Responsibilities :

  • Design and build the gRPC services at the heart of the Cloud Portal, APIs that other teams depend on and that must stay compatible as the platform grows

  • Take services end to end: design, ship, and run them in production, across both cloud and on-prem

  • Solve the performance and scaling problems that come with multi-tenant systems and large datasets

  • Help shape architecture and technical direction, where your input genuinely moves things in a team this small


  • 5+ years writing production-grade Go

  • Strong grasp of idiomatic Go, concurrency patterns, and profiling with pprof, plus a real understanding of escape analysis, allocation behavior, and what the GC is actually doing

  • Solid experience building and maintaining APIs using gRPC, including Protobuf versioning, streaming, and API lifecycle best practices (bonus: you know Google AIPs)

  • Proven experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), performance tuning, and schema design

  • Comfortable in cloud-native environments, applying caching, queuing, and observability best practices

  • Professional working proficiency in English, enough to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to peers and stakeholders

If you think that you don't meet all the requirements: With us, there are "no limits" to your development! Go your way with us - we support you! Just show us who you are.

What you can expect from us:

An environment that is always open to change and optimization. There is no "it's always been like this" with us. You have the opportunity to contribute your knowledge, design processes, standardize existing topics or optimize workflows. Be a source of inspiration and bring us even further forward with your expertise!

We create conditions in which you feel comfortable:

  • Home office contracts & absolute flexibility through free organization of working hours

  • Permanent position and 30 days of vacation

  • FlexWork: Work remotely from other European countries for up to 3 months per year

  • Monthly budget for individually selectable benefits from over 50 possible offers via emplu, various offers via corporate benefits, as well as bicycle and car leasing via salary conversion

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 free sessions with psychologists annually as well as access to meditations and courses

  • We provide you with targeted support in your professional and personal development at Natuvion

  • Mentoring program for a structured and personal induction

  • Be part of the #teamgreen - At Natuvion, you'll work on innovative projects as part of a team that stands up for each other. We rely on cooperation, openness and trust

  • Modern equipment and central offices in Walldorf, Berlin, Munich and Leipzig

  • Your long-term perspective is important to us, which is why we subsidize your company pension scheme as well as capital-forming benefits

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion is a digital moving company.

Our team does not move tables, filing cabinets or chairs. Natuvion transports business-critical data and processes from one technology platform to another. Typical Natuvion "relocation services" include data migration, data transformation, data integration, data privacy, data security, and data quality.

Our >400 consultants and developers in Germany, Austria, Slovakia, the USA and Australia have extensive know-how in (SAP)® projects and a profound understanding of processes across industry boundaries. With a lot of experience, commitment and commitment, they support our customers with advice, services and their own software technology. In this way, we enable companies to always use their data and processes on the most modern and innovative platforms.

Are you interested? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!
Feel free to send us your CV, we do not need a cover letter.

data.title: Working Student IT Operations (m/f/d)
data.description:
Hi!

We are Coffee Circle, Germany’s leading sustainable specialty coffee roastery based in Berlin. We offer the world’s finest coffee and equipment to over 150,000 customers online and in our Cafés, driven by our goal to make high-end coffee experiences enjoyable and accessible to all. We foster direct trade relationships with coffee farmers worldwide, pay high prices for the coffee beans, and ensure everyone involved in the value chain gets treated fairly and respectfully. For every kilogram of coffee we sell, we invest € 1 through our Coffee Circle Foundation e.V. to help support sustainable improvements in coffee-growing areas, such as providing clean drinking water, hygiene training, and coffee labs. With over 5 million euros raised in donations, we cannot wait to increase our positive impact with you on our team, one cup of coffee at a time.

Your role

  • Support the IT setup across our cafés, office, and warehouse, from POS systems and printers to tablets, routers, and Raspberry Pis.
  • Keep our UniFi networks and internet connections running and help troubleshoot issues remotely or on-site.
  • Maintain and provision devices, keep our hardware inventory clean, and support onboarding and offboarding.
  • Document setups, fixes, and processes in Notion so knowledge stays accessible.
  • Support practical GDPR and information security topics, including TOMs, deletion concepts, access management, and security documentation.
  • Report to our CTO and be part of our Tech Team.

Your profile
  • You’re currently enrolled at university, ideally in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field.
  • You have a basic understanding of networks and Linux and enjoy learning new technical topics.
  • You work independently, stay organized, and appreciate good documentation.
  • You have experience with UniFi, GDPR or ISO 27001 is a plus, not a must.
  • You’re happy to travel between our Berlin locations when needed. Being based in Berlin and working mainly onsite is non-negotiable for this role.
  • You are available 20 hours a week, 3 days a week. Based on your availability, you can choose the days you work (Monday to Saturday).
  • You’re fluent in English; German is a plus.

And this is what you will get from us
  • Flexible working hours. Our core working hours are from 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM, but of course we understand that Working Students have different needs.
  • Discounts on our coffee and accessories, as well as access to online voucher platforms like Corporate Benefits and FutureBens.
  • Access to platforms for mental and physical health, such as nilohealth, and the possibility to have access to Urban Sports Club M membership after 1 year with us.  
  • The best coffee in the office and quarterly coffee vouchers to enjoy your favorite drink at home with your loved ones.
  • Regular All-Hands meetings, coffee training, and interdisciplinary team events.

What we believe in

We are a purpose-driven organization. For us, growth means increasing our social impact in coffee cooperatives around the world and opening a new world of coffee to our customers. We strongly believe in authenticity and compassion to build strong and innovative teams. We cultivate a humble and playful mindset to create an endless learning experience for our team.

No matter your ethnicity, skin color, descent, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity – if the job description fits you, we can’t wait to meet you.

data.title: Senior Brand Partnerships & Licensing Manager (All Genders)
data.description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world's candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves, reformulated with less sugar and zero compromise on taste. We are 120 people strong, with 170+ SKUs and aggressive growth across D2C, retail, Amazon, and new European markets.

Our Brand Activation department is where we move from product to culture. We do that through limited editions: co-branded drops with entertainment IPs, licensing deals with cultural icons, collaborations that make people genuinely excited about what they are eating.

Are you a senior brand partnerships and licensing professional who closes deals, owns projects end-to-end, and has the network to make things happen from day one? If so, read on.


YOUR TASKS

  • Partner Identification & Pipeline Management: You proactively source, evaluate, and pitch licensing and co-branding opportunities across entertainment IPs, cultural icons, celebrities, and lifestyle brands. You run an active pipeline of 5-10 live opportunities at any given time and know which ones are worth pursuing for our brand and commercial goals.

  • Deal Negotiation & Contracting: You lead negotiations end-to-end and close with confidence. LOIs, licensing agreements, talent contracts, commercial terms, royalties, usage rights. You represent us in front of top-tier partners, agents, and IP holders and you get deals across the line.

  • End-to-End Project Management: You own the full lifecycle of every limited edition. Concept, LOI, product development, packaging redesign, legal sign-off, market launch. You keep cross-functional teams across brand, product, design, legal, sales, retail, and D2C moving in the same direction and on time.

  • Business Case & Performance Ownership: You build and own the business case for every collaboration: budget, margin, revenue forecast, and post-launch review. You track revenue contribution, retail sell-through, D2C performance, and brand awareness lift per edition, and use it to make the next one better.

  • Internal Alignment & Launch Enablement: You brief and align brand, social, ecom, and retail on launch strategy, content needs, and sell-in materials so every edition lands the way it should, in-store and online.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years in licensing, brand partnerships, or co-branding, ideally within FMCG, consumer lifestyle, entertainment, or a licensing/talent agency. You have taken 3+ limited editions or co-branded drops from concept to launch and can point to the results. You are a strategic thinker with a hands-on mindset and a proven execution track record.

  • You have negotiated and signed LOIs, licensing agreements, and talent contracts with full commercial responsibility. You come with a network of IP holders, agencies, talent managers, and entertainment companies that opens doors from day one.

  • You are comfortable juggling multiple complex workstreams at once, aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority, and holding a timeline without micromanaging. You have owned 6-7 figure budgets and built business cases from zero.

  • You communicate with confidence in both German and English. Native-level German and full fluency in English are required.

  • You take responsibility for your projects and your numbers, make clear decisions even when the path is not, and thrive where speed and ownership matter.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience working directly with entertainment studios, IP holders, or major talent agencies.
  • Background in FMCG, food & beverage, or better-for-you consumer brands.
  • Existing relationships in the DACH retail landscape with sell-in experience for limited editions.
  • Track record managing both D2C and retail launches at the same time.
  • Degree in Marketing, Media & Communications Management, Business Administration, or similar, though your track record matters far more than the diploma.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
For this role, you can choose whether to work from our offices in Hamburg or Berlin, or fully remotely from anywhere in Germany. If this sounds like a good fit, we would love to get to know you!

data.title: Principal Transformation Consultant (f/m/d)
data.description:
Über Valiantys 
 
Schließe dich Valiantys an und werde Teil von etwas Außergewöhnlichem!
Bei Valiantys sind wir kein typischer Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner – wir sind die treibende Kraft hinter beeindruckenden, bahnbrechenden Lösungen, die mit größter Sorgfalt für die Atlassian-Produktpalette entwickelt werden.
Wir sind Pioniere in der Bereitstellung modernster Tools für Teamzusammenarbeit und Produktivität. Denk an uns als das Raketentreibmittel, das Unternehmen antreibt und sie zu unvergleichlichem Erfolg und höchster Effizienz führt!
Stell dir nun vor, du begibst dich auf eine spannende Reise mit Valiantys und Atlassian – eine Reise, auf der Innovation keine Grenzen kennt und dein Beitrag im Mittelpunkt steht.
 

Als Principal Transformation Consultant übernimmst du eine strategische Rolle beim Aufbau wichtiger Kundenbeziehungen, bei der Umsetzung komplexer Transformationsprogramme und beim Ausbau unseres Geschäfts.

Du arbeitest eng mit Senior Executives zusammen, um Transformationsstrategien zu definieren und umzusetzen. Dazu gehören Cloud-Migrationen, technologische Modernisierung und unternehmensweite digitale Initiativen.

Diese Rolle verbindet strategisches Consulting, Business Development und technologische Führung. Ein wesentlicher Teil deiner Aufgabe ist consultative selling. Du identifizierst geschäftliche Herausforderungen, entwickelst überzeugende Value Propositions und wandelst Opportunities in erfolgreiche Kundenprojekte um.

Mit deinem Verständnis für Enterprise Software Delivery, den Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) und moderne Engineering Practices hilfst du unseren Kunden, ihre Transformation zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig die Präsenz von Valiantys in strategischen Accounts auszubauen.

Du berichtest an den Transformation Consulting Director.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

Kundenpartnerschaft & Projektdelivery

  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Executive Stakeholdern auf, darunter Director, VP und C-Level.
  • Du verstehst die Geschäftsziele, Technologielandschaft und Transformationsprioritäten unserer Kunden.
  • Du führst und unterstützt Consulting-Teams bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer, mehrstufiger Transformationsprogramme.

Technologie & Transformation

  • Du berätst Kunden dabei, ihre Software Delivery zu verbessern. Dabei nutzt du dein starkes Verständnis des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Developer Experience (DevEx), agiler Delivery, DevOps und moderner Engineering Practices.
  • Du begleitest Kunden bei Migration Readiness Assessments, Architekturentscheidungen und der Planung von Cloud-Transitionen.
  • Du bleibst auf dem neuesten Stand zu Atlassian-Innovationen, cloud-nativen Technologien, AI-Trends und neuen Software Engineering Practices.
  • Du übersetzt komplexe technische Themen in klare Business-Empfehlungen für Executive Audiences.
  • Du förderst die praktische Einführung von AI, indem du neue AI-Fähigkeiten, Enterprise Use Cases und deren Auswirkungen auf Software Delivery und Business Transformation verstehst.

Consultative-Led Selling & Business Development

  • Du leitest consultative Discovery Sessions, um geschäftliche Herausforderungen aufzudecken und Transformationsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.
  • Du entwickelst überzeugende Statements of Work, Business Cases und Executive Proposals mit Fokus auf messbare Geschäftsergebnisse.

Solution Design & Value Creation

  • Du entwickelst Transformations-Roadmaps, die auf die Geschäftsziele der Kunden abgestimmt sind.
  • Du arbeitest mit internen Practices zusammen, darunter AI, Cloud, ITSM, Agile at Scale und Developer Experience.

  • Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Frameworks, Methoden und Accelerators, die das Consulting-Angebot von Valiantys stärken.

Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Du agierst als Mentor und Sparringspartner für Consultants auf allen Ebenen und trägst zu Wissensaufbau, Kompetenzentwicklung und Team Performance bei.
  • Du teilst Marktinformationen, Kunden-Insights und Delivery Learnings intern, um Offering Development und Delivery Practices weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du förderst eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, Professionalität und Kundenorientierung im UKI Consulting-Team.

Essential Experience & Skills

  • 10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Consulting, in Professional Services oder in Enterprise Transformation.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung von Enterprise Cloud Migration oder Technology Modernisation Programmes.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Enterprise Sales, consultative selling und Business Development, mit der Fähigkeit, Opportunities zu identifizieren, Business Cases zu erstellen und Advisory Engagements in Umsatz umzuwandeln.
  • Starkes Verständnis von Enterprise Technology Environments, einschließlich Cloud-Plattformen wie Atlassian Cloud und AWS, DevOps Toolchains sowie ITSM- und PPPM-Disziplinen.
  • Starke Kenntnisse des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), agiler Methoden, CI/CD, Developer Experience und moderner Software Engineering Practices.
  • Verständnis für Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI und AI-assisted Software Development, sowie die Fähigkeit, deren Business Value und praktische Enterprise-Anwendungen zu erklären.

Standort & Arbeitsmodell

Diese Position ist in Deutschland angesiedelt.
Wir sind offen für Remote Work innerhalb Deutschlands, mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kundenstandorten.
Gelegentliche Reisen innerhalb der EMEA-Region können ebenfalls erforderlich sein.

Warum Valiantys?
 
Unsere Teammitglieder sind unser größtes Kapital, und wir setzen alles daran, dass Valiantys nicht nur ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist, sondern auch eine Plattform für persönliches Wachstum.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

The Boarding domain builds and maintains the platform that onboards merchants onto PPRO's network of the products and services that get our customers live, fast, compliant, and reliable. At the center of it all is the merchant: every system we build, every API we ship, connects internal teams and external clients around getting merchants onboarded smoothly. As a Software Engineer, you own live, public-facing APIs built to handle real scale, take on well-defined but moderately complex problems, work largely independently within the team, and own your piece of the boarding pipeline end-to-end.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build, test, and operate services within the Boarding platform, following the "you build it, you run it" mindset

  • Work largely independently on team-scoped tasks, seeking guidance from senior teammates and your manager on ambiguous or cross-team topics

  • Adapt quickly when priorities shift, re-plan your own work, communicate impact, and keep delivery moving without needing to be told twice

  • Take ownership of your commitments: proactively surface risks/blockers, follow through to completion, and hold yourself accountable for outcomes, not just output

  • Write testable, decoupled, readable code; write tests across the pyramid (unit → integration); use our observability stack to understand and improve the services you own

  • Participate in incident response for your team's services, using runbooks and systematic debugging; contribute to blameless postmortems

  • Collaborate closely with peers, other Boarding squads, and stakeholder teams (Compliance, Product, Risk); share knowledge and give/receive feedback openly

  • Bring energy and curiosity to the team, someone others enjoy pairing with and are inspired by


    • What you'll need to bring:

  • Self-driven and with a high sense of ownership/drive - you take a well-defined task and run with it

  • Comfortable with changing priorities; you re-prioritise your own work without losing momentum or morale

  • Strong sense of ownership - you follow through, and you don't wait to be asked twice

  • An engaging, inspiring presence in the team - someone who lifts the energy of the room

  • 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, ideally with some payments/fintech exposure


    • Technical requirements:

  • Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs

  • Event-driven microservice architecture (SQS/SNS/Kinesis or similar)

  • AWS cloud fundamentals (EKS, DynamoDB, or equivalent managed services)

  • Testing across the pyramid; comfortable with TDD

  • Observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent) - can read dashboards/alerts and act on them

  • Nice to have: Terraform/IaC exposure, payments or KYC/compliance domain background, hands-on use of AI tools in the SDLC

    • What's in it for you?
     
    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
     
    Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
     
    Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
     
    Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
     
    Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
     
     
    Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
     
    Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
     
     
    Our Principles: 
     
    We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
     
    We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
     
    We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
     
    We make things better: We boldly explore  new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
     
    We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

Data-driven failure analysis (transitioning from subjective assessment to component

Creating and reviewing standard operating procedures and participating in the early stages

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving.

  • You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

  • You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback.

What you need to succeed

  • You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering.

data.title: Werkstudent*in (w/m/d) - Data Science & Deep-Learning im Kontext Sprachassistenzsysteme - Karlsruhe oder remote
data.description:
Wir sind ein Startup für Sprachassistenten und Künstliche Intelligenz aus Karlsruhe und entwickeln moderne Technologien für Spracherkennung und natürlichsprachliche Assistenzsysteme.

Ein Schwerpunkt von KENBUN ist die automatische Spracherkennung (Speech-to-Text) im industriellen und medizinischen Umfeld. Für Deutsch verfügen wir bereits über sehr leistungsfähige Modelle. Aktuell bauen wir unsere französische Spracherkennung weiter aus und verfügen dafür über umfangreiche Trainingsdatensätze mit mehreren Millionen Beispielen.

Für die Qualität dieser Daten ist sprachliches Detailverständnis entscheidend: Sind Audio und Transkription wirklich korrekt? Werden Zahlen richtig geschrieben? Gibt es systematische Probleme mit Homophonen, zusammengezogenen Wörtern oder anderen Besonderheiten der französischen Sprache? Und welche Fehlermuster zeigt unser aktuelles Spracherkennungsmodell im praktischen Einsatz?

Zur Unterstützung suchen wir eine:*n Werkstudent:*in mit sehr guten Französischkenntnissen und soliden Python-Kenntnissen. Der Schwerpunkt der Tätigkeit liegt auf sprachwissenschaftlicher Qualitätskontrolle mit bestehenden Datensätzen und Modellen. Du arbeitest selbstständig mit unseren Tools und Daten, wirst dabei aber eng von unserem technischen und wissenschaftlichen Team begleitet.

Wenn Du zusätzlich Interesse an Machine Learning und Speech-to-Text-Modellen hast, kannst Du Dich gerne auch in weiterführende Themen wie Evaluation oder Modelltraining einarbeiten. Voraussetzung ist das jedoch nicht – wichtiger sind uns Dein Sprachgefühl, Deine analytische Arbeitsweise und Deine Fähigkeit, mit Python strukturiert Daten zu untersuchen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Aufgaben

  • Überprüfung französischer Audio- und Textdaten auf sprachliche und systematische Fehler
  • Analyse bestehender Datensätze mit Python und unseren vorhandenen Tools
  • Identifikation und Kategorisierung typischer Fehlermuster, z. B. bei Zahlen, Homophonen oder zusammengezogenen Wörtern
  • Interaktives Testen unserer französischen Speech-to-Text-Modelle durch eigene Spracheingaben
  • Optional: Mitarbeit bei Evaluation, Modelltraining oder weiteren Machine-Learning-Themen

Qualifikation

  • Französisch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2 oder vergleichbar)
  • Deutsch oder Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau
  • Solide Python-Kenntnisse: Du kannst bestehende Skripte verstehen, kleinere Anpassungen vornehmen und selbstständig mit Datensätzen arbeiten
  • Sehr gutes Sprachgefühl und Freude daran, sprachliche Besonderheiten und Fehler systematisch zu untersuchen
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Interesse an Spracherkennung, Sprachdaten oder Natural Language Processing von Vorteil

Benefits

Du machst aus Ideen einen starken visuellen Auftritt.

Eine Präsentation ist für dich nicht einfach eine Ansammlung von Folien. Eine Website muss nicht nur funktionieren, sondern sich auch richtig anfühlen. Und wenn Typografie, Abstände oder Farben nicht zusammenpassen, fällt es dir sofort auf?

Dabei sollst du nicht einfach nur bestehende Designs umsetzen. Wir möchten, dass du mitdenkst, eigene Ideen entwickelst und gemeinsam mit uns Lösungen gestaltest, die modern, hochwertig und unverkennbar Nelta sind.

Dabei legen wir ein großes Augenmerk auf unsere Unternehmenswerte – Vision, Verbindlichkeit, Fokus, Transparenz und Respekt – und gestalten danach unseren Alltag!

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben als Werkstudent Grafikdesign & Digital Design (m/w/d):

  • Du arbeitest konsequent innerhalb unserer Branding- und Corporate-Design-Guidelines und entwickelst diese gemeinsam mit uns weiter.
  • Du setzt deine Ideen in Figma eigenständig in überzeugende Designs und Prototypen um.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit Typografie, Farben, Bildsprache, Layout und digitalen Markenerlebnissen.
  • Du entwickelst kreative Designideen und bringst eigene Impulse aktiv in unsere Projekte ein.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere visuelle Kommunikation über unterschiedliche Kanäle hinweg einheitlich und hochwertig bleibt.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Management und weiteren internen Teams zusammen.
  • Du unterstützt uns dabei, komplexe Inhalte visuell verständlich und ansprechend aufzubereiten.
  • Je nach Erfahrung kannst du Designs nicht nur konzipieren, sondern beispielsweise mit Framer auch direkt als moderne Webseiten umsetzen.

Ein Tag voller Möglichkeiten: So könnte dein Arbeitsalltag bei uns aussehen!

Du startest deinen Tag mit einem kurzen Blick auf die aktuellen Designprojekte. Für eine wichtige Kundenpräsentation fehlen noch einige Visuals und zwei Slides brauchen dringend mehr als nur eine kleine Schönheitskorrektur. Du überarbeitest das Layout in Figma, bringst Struktur in die Inhalte und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer guten Präsentation ein überzeugender visueller Auftritt wird.

Danach geht es an unsere Website. Für eine neue Landingpage steht das Grundkonzept bereits, jetzt entwickelst du daraus ein modernes Design. Du probierst unterschiedliche Layouts aus, beschäftigst dich mit Typografie, Bildsprache und responsiver Darstellung und stimmst deine Ideen direkt mit unserem Team ab.

Nachmittags steht Social Media auf dem Programm. Für einen neuen Beitrag entwickelst du ein visuelles Konzept, das zu unserem Branding passt, aber trotzdem etwas Neues ausprobiert. Dabei arbeitest du nicht einfach eine Aufgabenliste ab: Wenn du eine bessere Idee hast, möchten wir sie hören.

Zwischendurch fällt dir auf, dass eines unserer bestehenden Templates nicht mehr zum aktuellen visuellen Auftritt passt. Statt es einfach weiterzuverwenden, entwickelst du einen Verbesserungsvorschlag und präsentierst deine Idee dem Team.

Am Ende des Tages hast du nicht nur einzelne Designs erstellt, sondern sichtbar daran mitgearbeitet, wie Nelta als Marke wahrgenommen wird.

Qualifikation

Wir sind ein Match, wenn du...

  • aktuell an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben bist – idealerweise in Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign, Digital Design oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • sehr gute Kenntnisse in Figma mitbringst und bereits praktisch damit gearbeitet hast.
  • ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Typografie, Farben, Bildsprache, Layout und moderne digitale Markenauftritte hast.
  • Design nicht nur „schön“, sondern funktional, verständlich und konsistent denkst.
  • eigenständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig arbeitest.
  • kreativ bist und Lust darauf hast, eigene Ideen aktiv einzubringen.
  • bestehende Branding- und Corporate-Design-Guidelines verstehen und konsequent anwenden kannst.
  • einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch hast und auch die Details siehst, die anderen vielleicht nicht sofort auffallen.
  • offen für Feedback bist und deine Designs gemeinsam mit anderen weiterentwickeln möchtest.
  • idealerweise bereits ein Portfolio oder aussagekräftige Arbeitsproben vorweisen kannst.

Nice to have

Besonders freuen wir uns, wenn du zusätzlich...

  • bereits Erfahrung mit Framer und der Umsetzung moderner Webseiten gesammelt hast.
  • mit der Adobe Creative Cloud, insbesondere Photoshop, Illustrator oder InDesign, umgehen kannst.
  • bereits Social-Media-Content gestaltet hast.
  • ein Grundverständnis für Responsive Webdesign mitbringst.
  • erste Erfahrungen mit Animationen oder Motion Design gesammelt hast.
  • dich für aktuelle Designtrends, digitale Produkte und moderne Markenauftritte begeisterst.

Du musst nicht jeden dieser Punkte erfüllen. Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du ein starkes Gespür für Design, gute Figma-Skills und Lust darauf mitbringst, dich kreativ einzubringen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Einschätzung fließt direkt in die Entscheidung ein.

  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung technischer Interviews oder in der fachlichen Bewertung von Entwickler:innen (z. B. als Lead, Interviewer:in oder im Rahmen von Code-Reviews).

Benefits

  • Eine klar umrissene Rolle mit wenigen Stunden pro Woche, gut vereinbar mit deinen anderen Projekten und Mandaten
  • 100% remote, Interviews finden ausschließlich digital statt
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Co-Foundern, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Eigenständiges, flexibles Arbeiten ohne Micromanagement

Erstes Kennenlernen Du lernst unsere Arbeitsweise und Philosophie kennen. Du hast die Gelegenheit, dich vorzustellen. Wir beantworten alle deine Fragen in entspannter Atmosphäre.

Fachliches Gespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti Ausführlicheres Kennenlernen mit Fokus auf deine Entwicklungserfahrung und deinen Blick auf gute technische Interviews. Gelegenheit zu gegenseitigen Fragen.

If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives.

This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey.

It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life.

What is the Role?

This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants.

This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient.

If you are looking for a quiet life, this is not the role for you. If you want to do meaningful clinical work from home and be part of a growing team that is changing how patients access medicine, it is.

This is a full-time role, working 40 hours per week. You will be required to work 1 Saturday per month, for which a day in lieu will be provided. This role is fully remote.

What Will You Be Doing?

  • Conducting video-based pre-assessment consultations with prospective patients

  • Taking detailed medical histories including current medications, relevant family history, and prior treatment

  • Assessing patient suitability for referral to Montu's clinical consultants

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential patient records

  • Guiding patients clearly through the onboarding process and answering clinical questions appropriately

  • Escalating safeguarding concerns and contraindications in line with Montu policy and national guidance

What You Need

Essential

  • NMC-registered Nurse with a minimum of 5 years post-registration clinical experience

An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

 

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

 

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

data.title: Staff Solutions Engineer - EU / UK
data.description:
Marqeta is seeking a dynamic Staff Solutions Engineer to:

  • Partner with our Business Development and Customer Success teams to help close new revenue opportunities with prospective and existing customers.

  • Lead the technical solutioning and consulting phases of sales opportunities, serving as the primary point of contact for our customers’ technical teams.

  • Have a deep understanding of Marqeta’s technical architecture and product solutions and the ability to present these solutions in a consultative manner aimed at setting up our clients for a sustainable business partnership.

  • Drive internal knowledge sharing, process enhancements, and strategic initiatives to elevate our organisational performance.

This role will be based out of our London office in Holborn two days a week. Please speak to the recruiter for further details.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead Technical Overview and Solution Discovery: Early in the Sales process you’ll present Marqeta’s technical capabilities to our customers’ product and engineering stakeholders as part of the broader vision of a Marqeta solution.

  • Designing Solutions: As a deal matures you’ll partner with Solutions Architects, Product Managers and other key internal teams to refine the Marqeta solution best suited to meet the customer’s goals.

  • Technical Consulting for Long-term Success: When we close the deal, you’ll be the client’s trusted technical advisor and their bridge to our implementation team. Solutions Engineering is foundational to our clients’ technical success by ensuring they are prepared, properly resourced, and supported with expert technical consulting at the critical early phases of their engagement with us.

  • Represent the ‘voice of the customer’: Solutions Engineering is primarily a customer-facing role, but we also play a pivotal role in the development and rollout of new products and services as we are often the first point of contact for our customers’ technical inquiries. You’ll participate in new product release trainings, assist with beta testing and provide a key link in the feedback loop between clients and our internal product teams.

     

This role is about generating and closing new opportunities, while playing a key role supporting the Business Development Team - here are a few key expectations:

 

  • Know the Tech: Quickly get up to speed on Marqeta's technical capabilities, the unique features and customer benefits our platform offers and how to speak with confidence, knowledge and credibility about what we bring to our customers. This is likely to include working with our Product and Technology teams, and serving as a liaison and "voice of our customers" when engaging with them.

  • Support the Sales Process: From your first day, you will be expected to work on real customer opportunities through a sales process, from initial engagement to pricing discussions to final contract negotiations. At any given time, you may be supporting as many as 20 - 30 opportunities in various stages of that process.

  • Engage with Customer Opportunities: You're someone who must love working with customers, most frequently, our customers' developers, product managers, engineers and even business heads. Our BD team will rely on you to ensure the key technical influencers at our customers (and potential customers) deeply understand our technology, what makes it different and better than that of our competitors, and how to quickly get integrated and live.

  • Trendspotting: As you engage with customers and our team, we think you'll have the best vantage point from which to spot key trends, emerging customer needs, and gaps in the market where Marqeta can have an advantage.

     

What We’re Looking For:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience.

    • Ideally 7+ years experience in a relevant Technology, Product or Sales Engineering role, ideally in the Payments/Fintech industry.

  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and relevant tools and technologies (e.g. JSON, Postman, GraphQL, XML, etc.)

  • Ability to ramp quickly with new technologies, adapt to changing circumstances, and apply creative solutions to unprecedented challenges

  • Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to lead presentations and technical consulting sessions via video conference

  • Ability to prioritise, manage, and deliver on multiple projects simultaneously

  • Team-oriented and collaborative

Nice-To-Haves

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related area

  • Demonstrated strong understanding of fintech (e.g. acquiring, networks, point-of-sale) and payments expertise, especially card issuing and processing

  • Experience writing solution summaries (e.g. Technical Statements of Work, Solutions Briefs, etc.) and developing swimlanes or flow diagrams (Lucidchart)

  • Experience as a software developer and/or product manager


Recruiter for this role

  • Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!)

Typical Process

  • Application Submission

  • Recruiter video call

  • Hiring manager video call

  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 4, 45 min calls

  • Offer!

Compensation and Benefits

  • Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

  • Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development

  • Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Wellbeing programs i.e. Modern Health, HealthKick and much more…

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

Marqeta is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), veteran status or uniformed service member status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information (including testing or characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Growth)
data.description:
Up to £100,000 depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Growth engineering at Fanvue exists to move core product metrics fast. It's a small team that reads out experiments every week, and the surface area is enormous: signup, onboarding, activation, referral loops, retention, and the funnels underneath all of them. There is far more worth testing than there are people to test it. This role exists to close that gap.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Full Stack Engineer to work on Fanvue's Growth streams, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data and Marketing to design, ship and iterate on high-impact experiments across acquisition, onboarding, activation and retention.

This is highly execution-focused. You'll be testing ideas in production within your first weeks, not writing specs about them. The team runs on a weekly experiment cadence with real readouts, so the loop between an idea and knowing whether it worked is short, and you own both ends of it.

It suits someone who wants to be judged on whether the metric moved.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Design, build and ship growth experiments across signup, onboarding, activation and retention flows

  • Own features end to end, from idea through implementation, measurement and iteration

  • Build and refine growth loops such as referrals, sharing mechanics and viral surfaces

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests, and read the results honestly, including the ones that kill your own idea

  • Partner with Product and Design to prioritise and scope what's worth testing

  • Improve the performance and reliability of growth-critical user journeys

  • Use analytics and data tooling to guide technical and product decisions

  • Continuously find and remove friction in creator and fan funnels

👀 Who You Are

  • Strong full stack engineering experience with a clear bias toward shipping

  • Comfortable across frontend and backend, and willing to go wherever the problem is

  • Experienced with modern web stacks such as TypeScript, Node.js, React and relational databases

  • Familiar with experimentation frameworks, analytics tooling and funnel metrics

  • Comfortable in ambiguity, with a strong bias toward action

  • Data-informed and outcome-driven rather than feature-focused

  • A clear communicator who works well with product, design and growth partners

  • High ownership, high agency, and an appetite for fast iteration

Nice to have

  • Experience in the creator economy, consumer subscription, marketplaces or social platforms

  • Hands-on with Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog or similar

  • A track record of growth loops you built that are still running

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You'd rather ship a scrappy test this week than a polished one next quarter

  • You want to be measured on whether the number moved, not on what you delivered

  • You're happy to kill your own experiment when the data says so

  • You go and find the opportunity rather than waiting for it to arrive as a ticket

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You prefer long planning cycles to fast iteration

  • You need tightly defined requirements before you can start

  • You optimise for technical purity over measurable impact

  • You're uncomfortable with a roadmap that changes when the results say it should

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Ship work that directly moves growth, activation and revenue, and see it in the numbers the same week

  • Work at the intersection of product, data and engineering, with high visibility across the business

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the work you do now sets the standard for years

  • Unlimited holiday

  • Hybrid working, with flexible hours according to when you work best

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Budget for growth and wellbeing, plus support with upskilling and development costs

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.
